game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Coastal Port – Lighthouse Point, the lighthouse on the point: the harbor master must handle rogue waves while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Priority Alert: Order elif checks correctly because only the first true branch runs.
theme: Coastal Port – Lighthouse Point: the lighthouse on the point
core_gameplay_loop: In Lighthouse Point, repeat each round: Order elif checks correctly because only the first true branch runs. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the alert_accuracy value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 13 consecutive correct decisions about alert_accuracy to power up the harbor master and open the harbor gate.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 9 (extended tier): Priority Alert
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Priority Alert' (Week 3 slot 13), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Lighthouse Point'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how alert_accuracy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue waves in Lighthouse Point.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 13.
